title: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly,
paragraphs:
When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly,
hidden behind the tents… holding my breath so I don’t disturb the moment.

No map.
No details.
Just a promise.
The morning feels thin and sacred. Abram does not argue. He does not demand explanation. He listens… and something inside him settles.
I stay still in the shadows, watching a man choose trust over certainty.
It makes me wonder how often I delay obedience until I understand everything.

Beginnings rarely come with blueprints.
They come with a voice… and a choice.

I am a witness, not a biblical character.
But watching him step forward awakens something steady in me too.
What if faith grows strongest in the unknown?
